Fixing ALL 8 known bugs in the Cortex unified DB system (identified Apr 13 audit marathon), then running 10+ audit gauntlet.

CURRENT STATE: I've read the ENTIRE cortex_compat_shim.py (870 lines) and confirmed the cortex_nodes schema. Ready to start writing patches.

FIX 1 (shim WHERE/SELECT bugs) — 4 sub-bugs identified:
  Bug A: WHERE clauses with `=` on distilled_tips columns fail. The _col_remap at lines 506-518 replaces column names in SELECT but does NOT handle WHERE clauses properly. When SQL is "SELECT * FROM distilled_tips WHERE condition = ?", the regex replaces `condition` everywhere including WHERE — making it "WHERE COALESCE(metadata->>'condition', '') = ?" which returns empty strings instead of actual data because condition/recommendation were MERGED into `text` during migration. Fix: For WHERE on condition/recommendation, map to text column instead.

  Bug B: INSERT-then-SELECT can't find row. INSERT via _insert_to_cortex() commits (line 303), but SELECT may use different cursor or stale data. Actually looking at code, both use self._pg_cur which is the same cursor. The issue is likely that after INSERT commits, a new SELECT creates a new CortexCursor with same PG conn — should work. Need to test.

  Bug C: predictions table queries return NoneType. cortex_predictions col remap (lines 521-537) remaps columns but WHERE domain=? becomes WHERE task_type=? which may not match actual data in the predictions table.

  Bug D: metadata JSONB extraction for condition/recommendation returns empty. Lines 506-508 use COALESCE(metadata->>'condition', '') but these fields were merged into `text` during migration. The COALESCE returns '' (empty string) not None — callers expecting actual content get empty.
